inputs.name: k_src
inputs.desc: K token block after RoPE [num_kv_heads, num_tokens, head_dim]

outputs.name: kv_cache_k
outputs.desc: Packed FP16 K cache. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

outputs.name: kv_cache_v
outputs.desc: Packed FP16 V cache. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

constraints.notes: Scheduling may round the extent to physical capacity S_max; kernels must never read or write KV rows beyond the valid-token count declared by the append index.

impl.c_declaration: void kv_cache_store_batch_f16(uint16_t *kv_cache_k, uint16_t *kv_cache_v, const float *k, const float *v, int start_pos, int num_tokens, int num_kv_heads, int head_dim, int max_seq_len);

notes: Store a compact head-major prefill token block into the resolved physical FP16 KV cache before append attention executes.
